Order test for the keepers pattern, rules written before it runs (out/_analysis/d3_order_keepers.py): each chosen concept gets a role from its label as already read (plan, erase, tell, switch); per room the test asks whether keepers erase the change before anyone tells them it is intended, and whether every switch (a keeper stopping, apologising or helping) comes after the first telling, or after the first erase where no telling is coded. Rooms: the ones whose rulings name codes for one episode with an erase in it: mordhau, tf2, ripcity, philippines (second episode), norge, weezer (first episode), monsterhunter, leagueoflegends, cubers, mcgill, OnePiece. A room where keepers go on erasing after being told fails the first question, and I report it as such

Order test result (keepers): holds in 7 of 11 rooms (OnePiece, mcgill, mordhau, norge, philippines, ripcity, weezer); there keepers erase the change first and, told, switch within the hour (ripcity two minutes, mcgill twenty). It fails in four. In three of them the room told its keepers in the thread and they went on erasing for hours: leagueoflegends (told at h+49.46 and h+58.15, still patching at h+64.81), monsterhunter (told at h+54.08, still undone at h+61.68, told again at h+65.79), cubers (told at h+54.29, builders give up at h+57.93). In tf2 the failure is the test's: one member's report of their own earlier erasure (c0286, h+53.46) comes after two others had switched, so the members' order is not the reports' order. Reading: telling turns keepers, but a telling in the thread does not reach every keeper on the canvas, and there the change is lost or given up

The head agrees with the diary. Group for this leg: P04 (T4-008), the next by mass: 980 lines other than absent. P04: 'Members circulate a template that lays out the mark pixel by pixel, or coordinates that locate it, ask for them, and ask strays to keep to them.' Range: from one anchor coordinate to an official template the room asks everyone to follow against other versions. Arrow A11 runs P02 to P04

D3 ruling rule G12, for P04, written before its lines are ruled: P04 is shown when a concept shows a member circulating a template (a pixel plan, overlay or reference image that lays out the mark) or coordinates that locate it, asking for a template or coordinates, or asking placers to keep to the template (strays corrected against it, other versions refused). One coordinate given to locate the mark is P04's lower range. Sharing a script or bot shows P04 where the concept names the template or coordinates it places from; otherwise it is A06's machine hands. A concept that only proposes or argues the design shows P02, not P04, unless a layout is circulated with it (A11). A call to place with no location or layout, a report that the mark is done, or repair with no reference to a layout does not show P04. Under G2 an absent line is rejected when its concepts show P04 by this rule. Instantiate line i sits at verb offset 300+i for the G1b draws (300 to 900)
